correctness.rationale: Invertible homogeneous linear substitution gives an exact projective cubic isomorphism; a symbolic certificate checks all terms. The affine chart is v²=f(u) with deg f=3, so the sole point at infinity is smooth; finite singularities correspond exactly to repeated roots of f. Nonzero cubic leading coefficient and odd degree guarantee irreducibility; local factorization identifies node/cusp. The standard cubic discriminant and c4-invariant yield the complete coefficient criterion, j formula and explicit stratum examples, all verified by exact symbolic arithmetic.
